defect: Cross-sheet placement scoring inferred physical pin sides only for bottom-primary selected variants, and suppressed side-transition penalties unless a sheet had a selected bottom-primary variant. Top-primary mixed variants and base-bottom endpoints were therefore mis-scored.
change: Resolve each zone endpoint's actual face from selected shape primary side and primary/secondary membership. Keep fixed-owner endpoints on their base face. Populate per-net bottom flags from actual endpoints. No acceptance thresholds or hardware limits changed.
scope: This is a placement heuristic penalty for cross-sheet side transitions, not a routed-via prediction. Routing is out of scope.

tests.hand_computed: 3-4-5 two-sheet fixtures: physical top/top costs 5; top/bottom costs 7.2 ordinary or 12.6 impedance. Cover top-primary secondary/bottom, bottom-primary secondary/top, selected bottom-primary, base-bottom without variant, and absent endpoints.
tests.independent_oracle: Independent physical-pad placement and heap-based MST on unchanged frozen geometry. Removed the same historical primary-side gating defect from the test oracle. Archived fixtures remain unchanged; zero ordinary-via-cost vectors remain exact assertions. Nonzero obsolete scores are not acceptance targets.
tests.negative_control: Restoring the prior estimator fails native_floorplan_contracts at 'top-primary alternate must charge its physical bottom pin transition' in 0.55 seconds.

carrier_qualification.visual_observations: Central SoM top reservation remains clear; bottom USB-JTAG group remains present. Changes include actual component poses (for example C4001), not just textual score metadata. Render inspection does not establish hardware safety, assembly clearance or thermal qualification.
carrier_qualification.timing_limits: Phase subset is not an additive decomposition of the complete wall time. Compilation was not timed. This was an isolated full carrier run, not a matched historical Python performance comparison.

screen_limits: All screens pass placement-contract/flow diagnostics with zero hard-red constraints. Construction screens are not independent full qualification. Initial repeat screen may overlap the final targeted test tail, so these are not controlled speed comparisons.
remaining: No new smaller board demonstrated. Existing contract-coverage and authoritative hardware-evidence gaps remain, including unverified proximity, assembly/height and thermal requirements. No new full devkit qualification in this batch. No fabrication-readiness or goal-completion claim. Historical Python comparison remains unresolved.
